mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without additional triggers.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of periods with FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (t-test p>0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.0% for two consecutive months signals severe labor market distress, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of triggered periods (t-test p>0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low federal funds rates (<0.5%) and high unemployment (>9.0%) indicate ineffective monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >55% of triggered periods (t-test p>0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 550,000 units signal strengthening consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days in housing recovery regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of periods with HOUST > 550 (t-test p>0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Sustained residential construction activity (HOUST rising) signals robust consumer spending, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days without triggers.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >55% of rising HOUST periods (t-test p>0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 90.0 for two consecutive months indicates manufacturing contraction, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of triggered periods (t-test p>0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%) prompts aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days in inflation regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >55% of periods with CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% (t-test p>0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Weak employment growth (<0.1% PAYEMS growth) combined with rising unemployment (>9.0%) signals labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >55% of triggered periods (t-test p>0.05 vs baseline).
